property_summary: After any successful call to setOwner, the contract owner must equal the address that was passed as the _owner argument; the buggy version violates this because it instead sets the owner to msg.sender, which matches _owner only when the caller passes its own address.
change_summary: Replace 'owner = _owner' with 'owner = payable(msg.sender)' so setOwner is a no-op that reassigns current owner.
